::: {.callout-note}
This is the **previous** 26-lecture Marp version of the course, kept for reference. The current, actively maintained decks (Typst / Beamer-metropolis) are on the **[Slides](slides.qmd)** page.
:::

The full 26-lecture course, in **HTML** (present in the browser) and **PDF** (download). Each deck is a self-contained ~80-minute lecture: an output-first opener, one worked idea per slide, 1–3 practice problems with solutions, and linked interactives, notebooks, and references.

**Lectures 1–15** map onto Andrew Ng's [Deep Learning Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/deep-learning) — watch his videos alongside. **Lectures 16–26** carry his method into modern topics he never taught.
